invite.heading: Join {{organisation}}
invite.body: {{organisation}} has invited you to join their workspace on Healthy360.

signedOut.title: Sign in to accept
signedOut.body: Accepting has to be attributable to a person, so we need you signed in first. Use the address this invitation was sent to.
signedOut.returnHint: We will bring you straight back here.

unverified.title: Confirm your email address first
unverified.body: Your address has not been confirmed yet. Confirm it and come back to this link to accept.

mismatch.title: This invitation is for somebody else
mismatch.body: You are signed in as {{current}}, and this invitation was sent to {{invited}}. Sign in as that person to accept it.

accepted.title: You are in
accepted.body: You have joined {{organisation}}. Your new workspace is ready.
accepted.alreadyTitle: This invitation has already been accepted
accepted.alreadyBody: Nothing more to do here. If the workspace is not showing up, sign out and back in.
accepted.noMembershipBody: We recorded your acceptance, but the membership was not created. Ask whoever invited you to check.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: It lapsed on {{date}}. Ask {{organisation}} to send you a new one — re-inviting always issues a fresh link.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: {{organisation}} withdrew it, or replaced it with a newer one. Check your inbox for a more recent message before asking for another.

notFound.title: This link does not work
notFound.body: It may have been mistyped, or the invitation may be long gone. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
